Proposed Hardware & Setup

The proposed kit combines a soil moisture probe, silicone tubing, a small water pump, sensors, and rechargeable power. Final accessories and specifications are subject to testing.

1

Place Device & Soil Probe

Insert the AquaPlanter device directly into the soil of an existing plant pot, with its sensor probe beneath the surface. The device is designed as a single self-contained unit with a soil-insert stake; the final dimensions and mounting design remain under development.

2

Connect Pump & Water Reservoir

Connect the proposed mini pump, reservoir, and tubing to supply water when needed.

3

Connect & Select a Plant Profile

The planned companion app would allow users to choose a plant profile and adjust watering and monitoring thresholds.

Frequently Asked Questions

The device is designed for existing plant pots. The whole device is intended to insert into the soil of an existing pot. Exact dimensions and compatibility are pending prototype testing.
The prototype design specifies a rechargeable 3.7V 2000mAh Li-ion battery. Battery runtime and charging options are not yet verified.
The design includes water-level monitoring and planned app alerts. Actual alert thresholds and pump safeguards will be tested.
The plan includes customizable plant profiles and remote monitoring. Subscription terms and app availability are not finalized.
